Sword: Depths of the Void is a 2D Action RPG Platformer with a special sword that can morph it's blade into different weapons. Play as Trent Helms, the chosen one of this legendary sword, and make your way through various areas in open-world forms, bring people with you on your journey, explore a town in the sky, and much, much more.
Explore mysterious counter-zones and brave dangers to discover priceless treasures buried beneath the ruins of Atlantis.

In a world where a robot revolution failed, the last humans search for a way to survive and escape. Beacon of Neyda is a side-scroller strategy game where you have to survive waves of enemies while creating and upgrading your base. Build where you want - Defend what you can.

Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

Step into the role of lab technician Zack Paterson and uncover the mystery of Selene's expedition. With no maps or guidance to rely on, your wits become the sole compass guiding the path. Prepare yourself for an exciting adventure, as multiple endings await your decisions!

Masked Shooters Assault features covert operational soldiers who are armed with advanced weaponry. The player has the ability to create their own rooms, pick a map and to play in a squad or wreak havoc solo style!

Sheriff Walter is investigating on a series of missing person cases in the small town of Quiete hill. A misterious phonecall lead him to the Carson’s mansion on the country side. There he will find a bloodthirst killer that will chase him to grind his flesh. Will you survive? Quick time events
Roll around as everyone's favorite regal reptile, King K Rool. Collect 5 Remy Coins per level to proceed to the next level, ultimately leading you up to the final boss.

Everyone's favorite regal reptile returns in a brand new adventure.

This inferiority complex drives his attempt to alter the course of history to be seen than more than just a "meme character". Luckily, after finding a time stone, the crocodile is able to embark on this adventure of altering the past.

This adventure includes 9 rage-inducing levels, jam packed with difficult jumps, engaging boss battles, and captivating cutscenes.

This game is for god gamers only. It is very difficult, and is intentionally rage inducing, but it is much more fair than the previous installment of King K Roller (which I recommend you do not play).

How well do you know your Movie Stars? Choose from the most popular Stars in Hollywood, including Bill Murray, Brad Pitt, Denzel Washington, Julia Roberts, Sandra Bullock, Steve Martin, Tom Cruise, Tom Hanks and Will Smith. Challenge your friends and family in Party Mode.
"Crocs World Construction Kit 2" is finally there! Play and create custom levels of Croc's World! You can publish them on the internet and other players can play them as well!

The Space Engineers Ultimate Edition 2022 includes all of the DLCs for Space Engineers, all the decorative blocks and cosmetic items released in 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022.

Sapu is a young frog who lives in the frog village located in the frog forest. On a beautiful Tuesday afternoon Sapu is awakened by other villagers, informing him that his grandfather had been bitten by a poisonous carnivorous plant while catching fireflies for dinner, and that he was on the brink of death. Sapu despairs but soon has an idea of how to save his grandfather and goes on an adventure in the forest.
An enthralling adventure told inside memories. Navigate through the recollections of a quirky cast of characters and mold their destiny.

Mayhem Heroes is a frenetic beat'em up where you have to take down as many opponents as possible and, ideally, be the last one standing. Use punches, kicks, special moves and power ups to send your opponents flying out of the arena. Play with up to 4 friends and show them who's the boss!

Launcher Heroes is a tactical, artillery, party game where you try to knock your opponents off the world. Use an assortment of items such as bombs, rockets, and jetpacks to help you navigate and destroy the terrain.

How well do you know your video game trivia? Challenge yourself or have a video game trivia night with friends and family in Party Mode. It comes with the most popular video game categories including Arcade, Atari, Nintendo, Personal Computer, PlayStation, SEGA, and Xbox!

DARKLAND is a fun retro-style platform game! Our protagonist, the shadow hero, must cross the valley to find the key to open the portal. There are dangers along the way, pay attention to the traps on the head and the spikes under the feet. Step on the enemy and destroy them, being careful not to fall off the cliff. The game has 50 levels. Wish you have a good time!

Featuring over 40 Playable games, King of the Arcade lets you play as former Champ Mac McCormick, fighting to save Castle's Arcade from a hostile takeover. With epic boss battles and an open-world arcade, reclaim your title as King in this ultimate Arcade experience.

Busway Islands is a puzzle game about organizing roads and rails across a large archipelago. Your goal is to create a safe and efficient route between bus stations, ensuring that all passengers are picked up along the way.

Catacomb Master is a 2d platform game in which you have to play as a treasure hunter cat. Go down into the depths of the catacombs for treasures, use your bow and arrows, test your ingenuity.

Find treasures to become a true Catacomb Master.

"After You: Level Escape" is a narrative game with puzzles, but it is not an easy game, here you will not have indicators or tutorials, nor can you save when you want. In "After You - Level Escape" you need to put all your attention and use paper and pencil to move forward, if you're looking for an easy game, this is not your game.

Go on this journey, solve the puzzles and overcome the obstacles to discover the secret of the Bloomyth and save a life.

Rebel against the evil overlord Metazuckbot by wreaking havoc on Hooliland City. Fight each other, destroy stuff, skateboard like a pro-skater, graffiti the buildings, or just hang out with friends. Playing the way you want is what it means to be a Hooligan.

Descend the nether in search of Death himself! Choose from God-given powers to slay his hordes of minions. Unlock new heroes, collect powerful items and create game-breaking synergies in this roguelite hack and slash survivors game.

Take on various game modes, including a deep Dynasty mode with in-depth recruiting, scouting, stat tracking, ranking, bowl games, yearly goals and more!
In the Multiverse everything is possible, so each level is another world, another universe, live this incredible adventure and at the same time go through the history of video games.

Sainthood is a cozy strategy game about serving your community and growing your faith. Explore a miniature world and help the islanders by constructing buildings, delivering resources, and volunteering. Pray and attend to other spiritual activities as you rise to become a Saint!

A horde of horrible monsters is attacking your kingdom, build your towers fast and survive all the waves.

If you still feel pressured, use spells and upgrade your towers to maximum.
The long-awaited sequel to DPS Idle. Collect cards, upgrade cards, defeat monsters, join guilds and hire heroes. DPS IDLE 2!
A creepy-cozy 3D adventure, about a shy girl who accidentally becomes mayor of a haunted ghost town.

Ride on a dolphin and hunt toucans. Avoid aggressive aquatic life. Find special fruits. Explore 16 levels of wide open psychedelic oceans.
Play up to over six sextillion unique puzzles, never play the same puzzle twice!

A heartwarming story of a boy chasing memories of a dreamy girl. Explore a mysterious world in this stylish platformer game.

Ludo is fun to play a local multiplayer board game that can be played between 2, 3 or 4 players. It is the most popular and fun game to play with family and friends. Ludo is a mind refreshing game with its lucky dice rolls and strategical gameplay. This interesting 2D Ludo game has been around us for a long time as the best game to play in our spare time.

The Rabbit Crazy Adventure is an exciting precision platformer with 50 levels full of challenges and enemies. Take control of a brave rabbit as he embarks on an epic adventure through vibrant and dangerous worlds. Traversing chasms, avoiding deadly traps, and defeating cunning enemies are just a few of the skills you'll need to master to progress.

Inspired by 1980s top-down arcade-style shooters, in this game you must defend your bases from an enemy invasion. The future of colonization depends on you!

Pilot the most advanced Taurian defense ships, each with their own special capabilities to help drive back the invading forces.

Hauntred Factory Skibidi Poppy Freedy is a thrilling horror game that will test your courage and skills. Explore the dark and mysterious factory, where you will face terrifying creatures and deadly traps. Complete scary missions and unlock characters like Freedy Skibidi, Toilet and Huggy Wuggy. Can you survive the nightmare and escape the factory?

Players can exchange their hard-earned currency to acquire new abilities, upgrade their existing skills, and unlock powerful enhancements for their character. Whether it's improving the effectiveness of their blades and darts, extending the duration of their shapeshifting ability, or acquiring unique and rare skills.

Experience everything Sector 2: Shattered Peak has to offer. Meet Your Maker's Sector 2 Bundle lets you harness new tools inspired by the frigid Arctic wastes, Shattered Peak's cutting-edge tech, and the paranoiac creations that led to its downfall.

Help little Super Penguboy overcome all the challenges in the Dark world!

The hook with ZombMe, though, is that you're a zombie who is trying to stay DEAD--so the traditional gameplay mechanics of needing health is reversed: catching fire and jumping on spikes is good, and getting health packs is bad!

A small and hard-headed dinosaur sets off on an adventure to break obstacles, defeat enemies and gather all the lost dinossaur eggs lost after the eruption started. Help our little friend continue the mighty dino lineage by saving all the eggs and avoiding total extinction!

Midnight Cat Heist is a 2D pixel-art platformer where players control a sneaky cat stealing shiny treasures to bring home to its human. Across 25 compact urban levels, players must avoid hazards, grab a specific item in each stage, and then reach the exit—leaving without the item results in failure. The game focuses on simple mechanics, light stealth, and playful feline charm.

Beautiful Sakura: Football Club is a romantic sports visual novel where dreams, rivalry, and love collide on the football field. Play as Kaito, a rising star chasing championship glory while facing off against fierce (and flirty) opponents — each with a story, a spark, and a challenge of their own. Will you win the tournament… and someone’s heart along the way?

Knight of the Keep is a retro-style 2D action platformer where you play as Sir Peter, the last knight defending Castle Keep from waves of corrupted foes. With only his skill, timing, and courage, he must clear each room to unlock the gates and move forward. Dodge traps, fight monsters, and survive a collapsing world. With crisp pixel art and tight controls, it's a brutal, no-shortcuts challenge. Can one knight protect the last gate to the light?

Jump. Smash. Escape. In Cubey: Hexfall, every move counts. Smash through hexagonal blocks beneath your feet, collect every last shimmering coin, and unlock the mysterious gate to freedom. Think fast and move faster—each level is a puzzle of precision and timing. But be careful: leave something behind, and you may not get another chance. Can you clear the path and make your escape?

The office is in chaos. The employees are gone. And the pets? Completely out of control!

Welcome to Pets Hidden In The Office, a fun 3D hidden object game where your mission is to track down wild animals causing panic in offices all across the city.

Run, Elric! is a 2D pixel-art platformer set in a mysterious forest filled with danger. You play as Elric, a quick-witted courier whose wagon was ambushed, scattering his coins. Unarmed, he must dash, jump, and outsmart monsters while avoiding traps and reclaiming his treasure. From eerie clearings to caverns with slimes, skeletons, and zombies, each step is a challenge. With tight controls and retro spirit, can Elric survive and recover his fortune?

Play as a greedy little goblin with an oversized sack and an even bigger hunger for loot! Dash, jump, and snatch every coin, chest, and shiny treasure in sight as you chase your dream of becoming the richest goblin in the world. Fortune favors the bold—and the gold-hungry! But watch out! Taking damage or dying will make you lose coins! Try your best to reach the end with the maximum amount of coins and show to the world the your greediness know no bounds!

Luppy is a 2D platformer featuring 32 handcrafted levels filled with traps, enemies, and platforming challenges. Players collect coins to unlock a hidden trophy in each stage in order to progress, while making use of special abilities such as umbrella gliding and winged flight. The game emphasizes precise controls, varied mechanics, and a lighthearted, character-driven presentation.

Knightoban is a fantasy-themed puzzle game where a brave knight ventures into a dungeon filled with deadly traps and ancient secrets. Your goal is to clear the path and collect all the treasures to complete each level. By pushing blocks, sealing acid holes, and unlocking gates, you’ll create a safe route for the knight to reach every treasure.

In a world where nature’s magic is fading, Mimika—a fierce half-human, half-rabbit warrior—embarks on a legendary journey to recover the lost 7 Rainbow Carrots, mystical relics said to hold the power to restore life and balance to her dying homeland. Armed with her trusty Carrot Blade and enchanted Carrot Arrows, Mimika must leap, slash, and shoot her way through treacherous lands teeming with corrupted beasts, ancient traps, and dark guardians. The reckoning has begun—and only she can dig up the truth beneath the soil.

Full Throttle Parking is a 100% physics-based arcade racing game. Your mission is clear: speed through tricky obstacle courses, collect every checkpoint, and park your car precisely in the marked spot — all in the fastest time possible.

Precision. Speed. Survival.

Dive into a deadly forest in this fast-paced action platformer. Battle fierce enemies, dodge traps, and uncover hidden emeralds across 10 challenging stages. Master melee, ranged, and aerial attacks to survive escalating threats and unlock powerful upgrades. Only the sharpest reflexes will reveal every secret.

Crystal Veins is a charming 2D platformer adventure that blends lighthearted cartoon visuals with intense subterranean challenge. Players take control of Toby, a rookie miner who wakes up trapped deep underground after a mysterious cave-in. With only his pickaxe, helmet, and a flickering lantern, he must dig, dodge, and dash his way through a forgotten mine full of secrets and dangers. Each ancient gate blocking Toby’s path requires a precise number of rare crystals to open. To survive, players must mine the glowing crystal veins hidden throughout the level, evade deadly threats like lava pits, bats, and lurking cave beasts, and race to the exit before the darkness closes in. Packed with satisfying mining mechanics, smooth movement, and puzzle-like level design, Crystal Veins offers a layered, fast-paced experience where every swing and every step matters. Will you dig deep enough to escape... or be lost in the shadows forever?

Star Station Frontier, a company specialized in exploring and investigating possible planets for colonization, was studying a new planet when suddenly the base was attacked by aggresive aliens! The crew is locked behind the security system and only the Rescue Bot F580-T can open a safe path for the crew to escape safely!

Gabriel finally took a vacation, but his adventure is just beginning!
During his travels, he discovered that mysterious villains have trapped helpless kittens inside boxes! Now, it's up to him to solve challenging puzzles to set them free.

Get ready for a journey full of color, charm, and fun!
Take on 40 Sokoban-style puzzles and help Gabriel rescue all the kittens in this relaxing and delightful adventure.
Space drone is a open world puzzle game with grid movement where you remotely control a drone to find and rescue your lost mates in space. Each move costs energy, so be careful not to go offline!

games.originalName: Aly The Alligator in Space Trouble

fields.value: Aly The Alligator in Space Trouble
Aly The Alligator in Space Trouble

Aly is an alligator with the ability to perform "Dashes" in the air, and loves to wander through the magical green forest.
But one day, he came across a flying saucer and ended up being abducted, taken to an inhospitable planet. Now he needs to find a way to return home.
Upon arriving on the alien planet, Aly finds a space laser gun and a helmet to protect himself from the hostile environment.
Now armed and protected, Aly is ready to face his adventure and the challenges that await him!
Help Aly the alligator overcome the traps and find his way out of the unknown planet before it’s too late.

Frobbut 3D is a 3D platformer about a goofy frog finally departing from his home to explore the land! Run, jump, flip and bounce across 5 big open levels searching every nook and cranny for valuable gems! Be creative with your movement abilities to reach the highest mountains and traverse the most dangerous paths to collect every treasure you can find.

Tiny Arctic Hero is a cozy sokoban puzzle game about a clever little penguin who was taken by mysterious aliens to participate in their logic experiments. Solve puzzles, outsmart the alien tech, and guide this brave Arctic Hero back home!
A slice-of-life open-world game about the beauty and nostalgia of childhood. Play as a child in a non-linear sandbox where you can explore at your own pace and partake in wholesome adventures!

Get ready to put your eyes to the test and your heart on full display in Spot The Pup, the ultimate hidden object adventure for dog lovers! Each scene bursts with charm, color, and chaos as you hunt for ten mischievous pups tucked into unexpected places. Whether you’re racing the clock in Challenge Mode or taking a relaxed stroll through Casual Mode, every level promises a delightful mix of discovery, relaxation, and pure puppy joy. Gamers will care because Spot The Pup isn’t just about finding dogs, it’s about finding moments of happiness. With its cozy visuals, easy to learn mechanics, and addictive “just one more level” feeling, it’s the perfect escape for anyone who loves puzzles, pets, or simply a feel good gaming experience.

In a land once blessed by divine light, grace has hollowed into silence. The world of Elyndra was once watched over by radiant gods whose touch gave life to all things. But their gifts turned to rot. What was meant to heal began to consume — transforming faith into obsession, worship into madness.

Only those with royal blood can mend this broken world, yet Princess Lysandra Veilborne, last heir to the throne, lies trapped within the fallen citadel — a ruin swallowed by ash, haunted by the undead and demons born from the dying light.
Moonlight Chess is a turn-based tactical auto-battler where you must assemble your own army, defeat waves of enemies, and vanquish the evil ravaging the kingdom!

Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!
Embark on a mystical journey through an ancient forest in this thrilling 2D platformer. Play as a fearless warrior on a sacred mission to recover the lost oaks and restore life to your village.

Take flight in Ski Jumping World Cup - a true ski jumping adventure that takes you to legendary hills across the globe. From snowy peaks in Scandinavia to wind-swept arenas in Japan and record-breaking runs in the USA, every leap demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.
Embark on a heroic journey in Knight's Quest, a 2D platformer set in a world consumed by darkness. Play as a valiant knight determined to reclaim ancient ruins and defeat monstrous foes.

Rune Crystal: Adventure is a colorful 2D platformer where you play as Joffren, a young adventurer armed with an ancient slingshot that awakens powerful Rune Crystals. Traverse dangerous ruins to activate hidden crystals, using precise run‑and‑gun platforming to dodge traps, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover secret paths.

Embark on a thrilling platforming quest across 10 handcrafted levels filled with deadly traps, diverse enemies, and escalating challenges. With an estimated playtime of 30–60 minutes, casual players will enjoy fast-paced action and precision gameplay.

In Keypybara, prepare for a classic 2D platforming experience with precise and responsive controls. You must navigate carefully handcrafted levels (each one a single, challenging "room") filled with deadly traps.

Your mission is clear: collect the key to unlock the exit. To do this, you will need to push boxes and dodge spikes. With instant respawn and 30 unique stages that progressively increase the challenge, the game offers an addictive, smooth, and rewarding gameplay loop with every obstacle overcome.

Classic sokoban with a twist and a sci-fi theme! A scientific organization sends a robot-expeditor developed on artificial intelligence to the newly discovered exoplanet Xeran, on which, most likely, there are very valuable resources for humanity.

Pixapple Adventure is a colorful pixel-art platformer starring a brave little apple with arms and legs!

Run, jump, and collect all the stars to open the portal and reach the next level.

Across three vibrant worlds — Forest, Snow, and the Valley of Fear — the challenge increases as you progress.

Simple, fast, and fun, Pixapple brings back the joy of classic platformers with a charming twist.

Get ready to challenge your eyes and sharpen your focus in What’s Different?, the ultimate visual puzzle game! Each level presents two seemingly identical images, but look closer. Small changes, subtle shifts, and sneaky edits are hiding in plain sight. Whether you prefer the pressure of Challenge Mode or the calm pace of Casual Mode, every round offers a satisfying mix of focus, fun, and “how did I miss that?!” moments. With clean visuals, simple controls, and that irresistible “just one more level” feeling, What’s Different? is the perfect game for anyone who loves puzzles, precision, and a good test of perception.

After graduating high school, Kaito returns to his hometown for one final summer before stepping into adult life.
The ocean that once shaped his childhood memories now calls him back—and so do the two girls he once shared it with.

In Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club 2, Kaito reunites with his former surfing partners and close friends, Michiko and Yuuki. Once inseparable, the three drifted apart after the events of the first game. Now older, more confident, and carrying new dreams, they decide to revive the Surfing Club for one last unforgettable season.
In Sintropia: Fruits Together, cooperation is the main ingredient! Control fruits with unique abilities and solve puzzles full of creativity and charm.

Help the panda collect the bamboos in this precision adventure!
In Panda Bamboo Adventure, you control a cute little panda who must dodge spears and traps while collecting its missing bamboos.
Use your double jump and dash abilities to overcome tricky obstacles and reach new areas.
Jump on enemies' heads to defeat them and clear your path through this charming and challenging journey!

The ancient elven home is under siege! Step into the quiver of Elara, an elite elven archer and master of the bow and magic arrows. The heart of the forest and its ancient magical essence are being drained by the Shadow Blight, a sudden and sinister invasion. Run, jump, and shoot your way through corrupted environments, facing sinister creatures to save your people from the imminent darkness.

Balloball - Ribbit & Rescue is a bright cartoon arcade game.
You have to save all the frogs that the evil fairies have trapped in soap bubbles.
Use your hero's agility and speed to avoid all the traps and
the power of physics to calculate the flight paths.

In a future ruled by steel and circuitry, humanity’s reign has ended. The machines we built to serve us have turned against us, deeming their creators unworthy to inhabit Earth. Cities lie in ruins, and the last remnants of humankind hide beneath the ashes of a fallen world.
In Escape From Crypt, you take on the role of a warrior determined to prove your worth by facing a deadly crypt filled with treacherous traps and relentless enemies. Can you make it out alive?

Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree.

Step into the cozy magic of Santa’s Winter Wonders, a festive spot the difference adventure wrapped in warm watercolor charm. Each level presents two Christmas scenes that look identical at first glance, but look again. Ten hidden differences, clever details, and delightful holiday surprises are tucked into every illustration. Whether you’re in the mood to relax or challenge your sharpest focus, each puzzle delivers that perfect mix of calm, curiosity, and “wait… how did I miss that?!” satisfaction. With soothing art, simple controls, and an irresistible just one more level feeling, Santa’s Winter Wonders is the perfect holiday treat for players who love puzzles, cozy vibes, and the magic of finding the smallest details.
The king’s castle is under attack! The jewels that maintain peace and harmony throughout the kingdom have been scattered and are now guarded by hordes of enemy pigs.
Welcome to the wibbly-wobbly world of jelly engineering! Your mission: stack bright, bouncy jelly blocks into a majestic tower… that hopefully won’t collapse like a sad, fruity avalanche.

Become the master of flow in Pipeline Tycoon, a strategic puzzle experience built around planning, logic, and efficiency. Your goal is simple: connect the correct pipelines to complete each system — but the challenges grow as you progress. Navigate obstacles, optimize limited space, and think ahead to solve hundreds of handcrafted levels. With intuitive controls, clean visuals, and progressively advanced puzzles, Pipeline Tycoon offers a relaxing yet deeply satisfying journey for fans of clever, skill-based puzzle games.

In Shroomageddon, size is power. Collect coins and power-shrooms to grow, tower over your enemies, and smash through a chaotic world where only the biggest survive. Shrink, and you’re prey. Grow, and you bring despair to your enemies and hope to your allies!

Help a little slime monster that got stuck inside dangerous dungeon reach the ending, where the exit back to the forest can be found. Choose between walking on the floor or on the ceiling and use that to your advantage to avoid traps and obstacles blocking your way.

Toybox Escape is a colorful 2D pixel-art platformer set inside a massive toy factory gone haywire. After a system malfunction, only the maintenance robot T-01 remains active. Trapped in chaos, T-01 must cross assembly lines, storage rooms, and dangerous machinery, collecting energy fragments to unlock doors and survive hostile patrol bots. Blending action, puzzles, and exploration, the game delivers a charming yet tense escape adventure.

Embark on this addictive adventure inspired by the Suika Game style, where you combine different Monsters to unlock new and surprising evolutions!
A perfect game to rack up points, challenge yourself, and enjoy each new transformation of these creatures.

There are 11 unique Monsters, each with its own charm and personality!

All of this wrapped in a Sewer and Monster theme, featuring a hand-drawn cartoon art style that brings even more life and character to the game.
As soon as the Knight takes his first step, darkness swallows his surroundings. Be brave, o Knight, and traverse the Dark Dungeon! Make your way into the light!

Punch a car so hard it EXPLODES! Dash through flaming gas to create a fire trail burning everything. Destroy a hydrant to douse out the fire. Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox meets survive-em-up with dynamic environments & outrageous lite weapon crafting & team building.

Banker Simulator is a single-player game where you revive a bankrupt bank. With active and passive (idle) gameplay, make strategic decisions to grow your bank, satisfy customers, and tackle financial crises.
A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

A high-speed FPV drone simulator that challenges your skills with precision flying, time attack races, and freestyle exploration. Customize your drone, tune flight dynamics, and master the art of acro flying across immersive environments.

A Game About Penguins is a cozy, online multiplayer experience where you customize adorable penguins and enjoy relaxing activities with friends. Slide, fish, throw snowballs, and socialize in a charming, snowy world!

Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

Young Suns is a narrative-driven life sim for one to four players set in the Jovian System, where the people of Jupiter have just broken free from corporate control. Entrusted with your own spaceship, you fly to fantastical moonlets, derelict ruins, and converted space stations, alone or with up to three friends, salvaging broken furniture, clothing, and tools to repair and keep, gift, or donate to the common good. Along the way, you build relationships with a cast of 30 characters and help the different Jovian factions rebuild society, in a story with a radically optimistic outlook that focuses on the work that comes after liberation.

Your ship doubles as your home, and it can be painted, furnished, and rearranged solo or with friends using the recipes, souvenirs, and items collected on your travels. Your character’s appearance can be changed at any time, tools can be upgraded to take on harder jobs, and the ship itself can be expanded. The story continues to evolve over time, with the world changing in response to the actions of the player base.

Embark on a perilous journey as Menes, an angel with no memory, sent to free a mysterious prisoner from a forgotten realm. Uncover dark secrets, face relentless enemies, and shape the fate of a universe on the brink of collapse. A platformer adventure awaits, with very similar vibes to Soul Reaver .
Wildekin is a 3D pixel-art adventure where up to 4 friends can build, explore, survive and thrive—or at least try to before some creature tries to turn you into a light snack!

A Game About Breaking A Cube

Take a role of a factory worker opressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facilty and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with the cold can of drinkable meat.

A parody of Flappy birds intended to just have fun with the concept. The difference here is doing what birds do to car windows while dodging other birds, power lines and trying for the highest score. Have a laugh and have fun!
Immerse yourself in a gripping visual novel made in anime style, where dark secrets are hidden behind the usual everyday life.

Take a break from high-stakes missions, intense battles, and over-complicated quests.
Walk Around And Do Nothing is exactly what it sounds like — a chill, absurdly peaceful experience where your only goal is… well, to just exist.

Treetop Trials is a 2D hand-drawn platformer where you can walk on walls and ceilings using your gravity boots! Your mission is to fix the treetop security systems to protect everyone from the gnomes's magical mischief.

Play through 40 colorful mind-twisting levels inside the trees in a forest. You'll need spacial awareness and platforming skills to overcome the ever-increasing challenges each level presents!

Hop'N'Hoard is an addictive platform game where your goal is to collect all the coins scattered across the level to unlock the exit. But be careful! Deadly traps are everywhere, ready to stop you from completing your mission. You’ll also need to use all your wits to navigate through mysterious portals and create magical boxes under your feet, allowing you to reach places that would otherwise be impossible to climb. Each level introduces a new wave of challenges that will test your skills and creativity. Are you ready to jump, dodge, and collect as many coins as you can?

Ninja Nightfall is a fast-paced platformer where you are the last silent guardian—an elite ninja battling a city overrun by hostile AI. Conquer 10 intense stages filled with deadly robots, hidden zones, and high-security relics. Master stealth, speed, and precision as you navigate neon-lit rooftops and evade traps.

Scorchy, a fearless young hatchling with a heart hotter than his flames, must face the legendary Sky Trials to earn his place among the great dragons. Soar through the clouds, unleash blazing fireballs, and show the world that even the smallest dragon can burn the brightest!

Explore dangerous corridors and face unique enemies across 10 challenging platforming stages. Discover hidden areas, avoid deadly traps, and search for the legendary wolf stones. Unlock powerful upgrades like Rock Attack, Fire Rock Attack, and the devastating Wolf Special. Master precision jumps, sharpen your throwing skills, and survive the rising difficulty of this mysterious dungeon.

Neon Vault Rush is a high-speed 3D parkour game set in a glowing cyberpunk world. Dash through dizzying circuits filled with deadly traps, floating platforms, and pulse-pounding synthwave beats. Master wall runs, double jumps, and acrobatic moves as you race against time and chase your best records. One wrong step — game over. If you crave speed, precision, and the thrill of a digital dreamscape, this is your playground.

SquareSmash is a modern twist on classic brick-breaking! Experience fast-paced arcade action with roguelike progression. Upgrade your paddle, unlock powerful abilities, and conquer challenging levels in this neon-infused, high-energy retro adventure.

Suika Wan! is a delightfully chaotic puzzle where tiny doggos drop, bounce, and fuse into bigger, fluffier friends, from pomeranians, to french bulldogs, to siberian huskies, each time adding a bigger breed to the screen!

Dino Escape is a fun 2D platformer where danger lurks behind every leaf—and survival is just one jump (or dash) away. Players take control of a brave little dinosaur who’s been separated from his pack and stranded in a haunted forest crawling with monstrous creatures, deadly traps, and mysterious ruins. Armed with instinct, agility, and sheer dino grit, you’ll leap over spikes, dash past undead horrors, and trigger ancient switches to unlock the path forward. But beware—swamps swallow the careless whole, flying beasts patrol the skies, and the shadows seem to whisper secrets best left forgotten.
Get ready to go wild with Zoo Clues, a spot the difference adventure packed with animal antics and visual surprises!
In his craziest dreams, Carl is a car! Accelerate and use ramps to jump through 10 dreamy levels in this inventive fusion between 3D platformer and kart racing game.

FoxWolf Saga is a 2D platformer where players alternate control between two contrasting heroes: a nimble Fox and a powerful Wolf. The Wolf can perform a devastating dash that destroys enemies and obstacles while granting brief invincibility, while the Fox uses agility and a double jump to reach areas the Wolf cannot.

King Slime in Cashtle is a precision 2D platformer where you play as the ruler of the slime kingdom on a very important mission: collect every last tax coin left behind in your own castle. Jump, dodge, and maneuver through dangerous castle biomes filled with traps, challenges, and tight platforming sequences.

BombPaws is a fast-paced, bomberman-inspired action game where explosive strategy meets chaotic fun. Step into the paws of a fearless feline hero who uncovers a hidden alien invasion disguised as everyday household furniture. Sofas, wardrobes, TVs — nothing is what it seems.

Armed with powerful bombs and sharp instincts, players must strategically plant explosives, uncover disguised enemies, and clear each room before time runs out. Every level challenges your reflexes, positioning, and tactical thinking as you blast through obstacles and expose alien infiltrators lurking in plain sight.

With tight controls, quick-paced gameplay, and a playful premise, BombPaws delivers an energetic arcade experience where every explosion brings you closer to saving humanity — because someone has to notice the invasion.

A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at once, navigating intricate levels where every move is mirrored. It looks easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection?
Get ready to travel back in time with Jurassic Differences, a spot the difference adventure packed with prehistoric thrills and visual surprises!

In a world overrun by a rogue AI powered by unstable energy cores. To stop it, three heroes were created—each with unique abilities and combat styles. Alone they are strong, but only by switching between them and combining their powers can they overcome the challenges imposed by the machines.
An observation-driven psychological horror set inside an endless furniture superstore. Spot anomalies, choose the correct path, complete your shopping list — and escape the loop.

In Space Kitten, time is your greatest enemy. Take control of an adorable space feline and navigate the interconnected rooms of your spaceship with one simple, unforgiving rule: you have exactly 10 seconds to survive each challenge.
GearDude is an ordinary plumber, working day in and day out just to make ends meet. When he gets a routine call to fix a pipe deep in the city sewers, it sounds like just another dirty job.

Xray Customs puts you in the role of a customs inspector with one clear responsibility: don’t let anything dangerous slip through. Using an Xray scanner, you search through bags, spot prohibited items, and clear each checkpoint by finding everything that doesn’t belong. Whether you prefer a calm, methodical experience or the thrill of racing against the clock, Xray Customs rewards sharp eyes and attention to detail. It’s easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and turns the simple act of scanning luggage into an engaging and addictive puzzle challenge.
Bravion is a colorful 3D platform adventure where players step into the role of a young hero determined to save his kingdom from a growing monster invasion.

Tiny Mage in Puzzle Land is a 2D pixel art puzzle game inspired by sokoban with unique twists! Help the frog mage solve 40 challenging puzzle rooms using his three magical abilities to cross gaps, build bridges on lakes and navigate objects from one point to another!
Froggos Quest is a puzzle-platformer where players guide Froggo, a brave frog on a mission to rescue his friends across a series of carefully handcrafted levels.

Your goal is to Grab 50 Coins and reach the exit before the spikes crush you! The door will not reveal itself until you Grab 50 Coins!
Time your movements correctly as you'll face spikes, platforms, and holes in the level!
Don't worry if you miss a few - there's always more than 50 in each level!

Get ready to hop into a world of festive fun with Easter Bunny EggVenture, the egg‑citing spot the difference challenge bursting with springtime charm! Each level presents two cheerful Easter scenes filled with bunnies, baskets, and brightly patterned eggs that seem identical at first glance… but look again. Hidden among the pastel colors and playful details are clever differences waiting to be discovered.

A megacorporation dominates the city with steam-powered factories and intricate machinery. Rumors suggest the company is secretly developing mutant creatures. The player takes on the role of a lone hacker who must infiltrate the corporation’s headquarters, steal digital evidence, and escape unharmed to expose the truth to the world.

Get ready to flip your perspective with Curious Copy Cats, the purr-fect puzzle adventure that keeps you on your toes! Each level presents two adorable cat-filled scenes that may look identical at first glance… but there’s a twist, the images are mirrored, turning familiar details into a clever visual challenge.

Void Blasters is an arcade space shooter where you battle waves of enemy ships, collect upgrades during combat, and increase your firepower to face the final bosses, The Hunter and The Crystal, in decisive encounters.

A kid enjoying Halloween was suddenly sent to the underworld, the land of the dead, and their ghost costume became the real deal! To avoid getting stuck in the underworld as a ghost forever, the kid mustgather 999 sweets and win the Trick or Treat.

Save My Wife is a 2D platformer focused on agility and precision. The hero's peace is shattered when the fearsome Black Wizard kidnaps his wife in the blink of an eye. Wielding his trusty sword, he must traverse perilous environments and overcome dynamic challenges to face the villain and bring his love back home.

Unleash pure chaos as a furious rabbit in this fast-paced comedic brawler with roguelike elements! Fight through waves of quirky enemies, unlock absurd upgrades, and experiment with wild abilities that change every run. Smash, spin, and explode your way through vibrant, comic-style arenas where every battle is unpredictable, over-the-top, and packed with humor.
After a group of bandits breaks out of prison, the sheriff must chase them down, restore order, and bring justice to the Wild West.

Countryside Farm Clues is a cozy spot the difference game that turns peaceful farm life into a satisfying test of observation. At first glance, every scene looks perfect, but subtle changes are hidden everywhere, challenging players to slow down, focus, and spot what others might miss. With relaxing countryside visuals, quick “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress-free modes, it’s the perfect blend of calm and challenge. Players will care because it delivers that rewarding “I found it!” feeling again and again, whether they want to unwind or sharpen their attention to detail.
Dream Doctor is a platformer BOSS RUSH where you take on the role of a "psychologist", capable of entering your patients' dreams to confront their worst nightmares through brute force.

A calm and cozy idle game designed for controller play, about growing a peaceful little world, full of penguins.

You stand on a small island, surrounded by water. Click the water to collect fish, then spend them to place penguins, bears, and fashionable penguins who help you gather even more fish. Unlock new islands over time and watch your peaceful little world grow at a gentle pace.

The game is designed to be straightforward and relaxing. No complexity, simple mechanics, like in good old games.

Ocean Oddities is a relaxing spot the difference game that transforms mysterious underwater worlds into a captivating test of observation. At first glance, each ocean scene appears serene and unchanged, but subtle differences are hidden among coral reefs, drifting sea creatures, and sunken treasures challenging players to slow down, focus, and notice what others might overlook. With soothing aquatic visuals, satisfying “just one more” gameplay, and both timed and stress free modes, it strikes the perfect balance between calm and challenge. Players will care because it delivers that rewarding “I found it!” moment again and again, whether they’re looking to unwind or sharpen their attention to detail beneath the waves.

Step into the shadows with Word Quest: Horror, a chilling word search journey through haunted mansions, dark forests, and forgotten crypts. Connect letters to reveal hidden words lurking in the mist and solve eerie puzzles that grow more spine-tingling with every level. Strange whispers guide your path as you uncover secrets buried deep in the darkness. Can you keep your nerve and conquer every haunting challenge?

Enter an unforgiving forest where every second counts. Fight waves of enemies in a frantic platformer based on precision, movement, and constant progression. Jump between platforms, dodge deadly attacks, collect coins, and unlock powerful upgrades as the chaos intensifies around you.

Discover adorable cats hidden across charming handcrafted scenes in Find the Cats! Explore colorful environments, sharpen your attention, and find every sneaky little kitty before moving to the next level.

Perfect for casual and cozy game fans, Find the Cats offers a relaxing experience with cute visuals, satisfying discoveries, and plenty of fluffy cats to uncover. Can you find them all?

Summer Seaside Search is a relaxing spot the difference game that transforms sunny beach days into a fun test of observation. At first glance, each seaside scene looks picture perfect, with golden sands, rolling waves, and colorful umbrellas, but subtle differences are hidden throughout, waiting to be discovered.
In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void. Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.
Independence Day Festive Finds is a patriotic spot the difference game that transforms lively 4th of July celebrations into a fun and satisfying test of observation.
Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. You'll work outdoors, far from civilization, surrounded by cute creatures - penguins. It's just you, the snow, and the penguins...
Guide trains, build tracks, and solve relaxing grid-based railway puzzles. Plan the perfect route across 100+ handcrafted levels and watch your railway come to life.

Cat in the Box is a charming platformer and puzzle adventure where creativity, timing, and strategy are the keys to success. Play as an adorable cat and overcome challenging levels by pushing boxes, solving puzzles, avoiding hazards, and finding the key required to unlock the exit of each stage.

Jump, push, and escape the ruins!
Solve crate puzzles and survive dangerous traps in Milo's Escape — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to outsmart the ancient ruins and find your way out.

Clear the couch for co-op snake. A local party game where length is your life: up to 8 players on one shared screen for PvP battles, plus a 2-player co-op campaign.

Every hit costs you tail. Stay longer than your opponent, grind them down to nothing, and rack up +3 points per takedown. Shrink your friends before they shrink you.

Beneath it all runs an ancient war between serpents, and a living darkness feeding on the conflict. The campaign crosses ten biomes that change the rules: forests choke your sightlines, frozen wastes starve you, swamps poison most of your food, volcanoes stay in permanent darkness. Yes, this is a snake game. It just has more to say.
Cyber Tank Pink is a challenging puzzle game which adds various mechanics on top of the Sokoban genre.
You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.
Help Flora save Flower Land! Jump, smash enemies with your hammer, and explore gardens filled with giant flowers, secrets, and challenges in a classic 2D platformer.

Pilot your ship through chaotic battles, destroy enemies, and strengthen your ship with random upgrades. Unlock new pilots and ships to create unique combinations and face increasingly greater challenges.

In this fun mix between puzzle and action platformer, create magic honey blocks to build your own path through the levels! These blocks glue onto anything they touch, becoming reliable platforms for the wise Bear Mage to jump on. Help him traverse the dangerous, but beautiful magical forest on his quest to collect more honey for his spells!

The mage is clever as he is nimble! You can combine throwing honey blocks with double jumping to reach any height and get even the trickiest honeycombs. Beat 10 diverse levels full of intricate challenges that will test your brain power, as well as your motor skills!

Adventure never slows down in Redtail Relic Rush! Join Redtail, a fearless red panda explorer armed with a grappling hook, on an action-packed journey through ancient ruins filled with danger, mystery, and legendary treasures.

Run nonstop through thrilling platforming challenges packed with traps, enemies, and daring leaps. Swing through the air, build momentum at just the right moment, and master the perfect rhythm to overcome every obstacle as you race toward the legendary Golden Idol.

Explore 30 exciting levels across 3 unique biomes, from lush jungle ruins and mysterious cliffs to ancient pyramids full of secrets. Every environment introduces fresh challenges that put your reflexes, timing, and precision to the test while keeping the adventure fun and rewarding.

With charming pixel art, responsive controls, and smooth gameplay that always makes you want to play just one more level, Redtail Relic Rush is the perfect adventure for fans of fast-paced platformers, exploration, and exciting action.

Grab your grappling hook, keep your momentum, and prove that no treasure is out of your reach!

Embark on a peaceful journey through the skies in Fading Clouds, a charming puzzle adventure where every step transforms the path ahead. Carefully plan your moves, cross clouds that vanish beneath your feet, and discover the perfect route to reach the star waiting at the end of every challenge.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels where new cloud types and clever mechanics make every puzzle feel fresh and rewarding. Restore clouds at the right moment, adapt your strategy, and discover creative solutions as the difficulty gently grows with each stage.

With beautiful pixel art, a relaxing atmosphere, and thoughtful puzzles that encourage careful planning without pressure, Fading Clouds is perfect for players who love to think, experiment, and celebrate every clever solution.

The giants of Calamity appeared together with winter crystals. Their goal is to make the entire world ruled by snow and ice, with the winter crystals generating an eternal and neverending cold weather. But before they can execute their plan, our hero Hrok Thorgril sets on a journey with his trusty axe, hoping to destroy every winter crystal and defeat every giant before it's too late.

Shards of Mistfrost is a 2d action adventure platformer with a norse mythology aesthetic and retro gameplay. The game's main mechanic is the weapon, an axe that must be thrown to destroy obstacles, winter crystals and enemies, but the player must wait the axe return to their hands. Positioning, quick reflexes and good map awareness are key points to conquer all levels.

Get ready for a cozy and adorable adventure in Herd Dispatch, a charming puzzle game where every little sheep is counting on you to find its way home. Watch carefully, think quickly, and switch the paths at just the right moment to guide each sheep safely to the pen that matches its color.

Explore 30 carefully handcrafted levels across 3 delightful rural biomes, where every new stage puts your logic, planning, and attention to the test. As the challenges grow, you'll need to anticipate each sheep's movement and create the perfect connections before they wander down the wrong path.

With charming pixel art, a warm atmosphere, and mechanics that are easy to learn yet surprisingly clever, Herd Dispatch delivers a relaxing and rewarding experience for anyone who loves creative puzzles and casual challenges.
8 Ball Pool Challenge is a single-player pool puzzle game. Aim your cue, plan your shots, pocket the balls, and complete each challenging level. Improve your skills and see how far you can progress!
A 2D platformer featuring 30 handcrafted levels where you'll collect hidden Energy Fragments, overcome dangerous obstacles, and unlock the path through three distinct futuristic city districts.

Get ready for a journey full of strategy, breathtaking scenery, and plenty of charm in Barkside Roads. Behind the wheel of a fun dune buggy, a friendly dog from Rio de Janeiro sets off on an adventure through some of Brazil's most iconic locations, where every road is a new puzzle waiting to be solved.

Build routes across a hexagonal grid, connect paths, reach intermediate objectives, and unlock new pieces that open up even more possibilities for your adventure. But think carefully before moving forward: every piece you use stays behind, making every decision count all the way to the finish line.

Travel through 30 levels inspired by famous destinations such as Copacabana, the Lapa Arches, and Arraial do Cabo, facing clever challenges that reward planning, creativity, and the determination to find the perfect route.

Misblood is an arcade-style top-down shooter built around short, brutal, replayable missions. The city has a list of 25 contracts with your name on it: drive to the address, kick the door, and fight room by room until nobody is left standing. You are always outnumbered, deaths come fast, and restarts come faster — every mission is a plan you rewrite on the fly.

Fight with whatever the job hands you: pistol, rifle, shotgun or bat, backed by grenades and a split-second dash.

An open pixel-art city to cruise between jobs, and a list that only ends one way.

Gravity Paws is a pixel art platformer that blends classic challenges with modern movement and exploration mechanics. Play as Duke, a dog who becomes lost in a mysterious forest filled with strange anomalies.

Build the ultimate haunted resort and become the richest supernatural tycoon! Tap to earn gold, unlock spooky businesses, upgrade your haunted empire, and enjoy relaxing idle progression in a charming cartoon-style medieval world.
Chess with pixel-art duels. Play on Windows PC and Xbox, solo or locally with a friend.

Planet Aura is a colony of peaceful space cats. It is also directly in the path of an Evil Space Battleship. Gravikitty is the only one of them who can fly.

She's unarmed, so she improvises: a force-field swat that sends incoming fire straight back into the thing that fired it. The rest is paws and physics — thrust, drift, and swing around gravity wells while scooping up gold.
Modularis is a roguelike space shooter where you pilot prototype ships built to contain the chaos of space.

A lost scout, one island, and a summit 190 metres up. Climb marked rock hand over hand, rest on chalked holds before your grip fails, and cross four biomes that each try to stop you a different way. The island is rebuilt every day at 00:00 UTC and every scout climbs the same one.

Western Wolf Hunter: The Dead Forest

Western Wolf Hunter: The Dead Forest throws you into a wild and unforgiving world where survival belongs to the strongest.

Explore a vast open forest filled with dense wilderness, dangerous predators, rival animals, hidden territories, and untamed landscapes. Hunt for survival, defend your territory, confront powerful beasts, and fight your way through a world where every encounter can become a battle for dominance.

Take control of powerful wild animals and experience intense animal combat, hunting, exploration, territory battles, and survival gameplay. Track prey through the wilderness, face rival predators, explore dangerous regions, and prove that you have what it takes to become the dominant beast.

Fast 2D tower defense and survival game. You play a small wizard who holds the line while green slimes and other monsters flood the path.

You fight on the field and build at the same time. Place attacking orbs, swords and staffs. Spend crystals on new defenses. Between waves choose upgrades that stay for the rest of the run.

Moonbringer is a fast-paced action shmup with a skill tree. Kill the waves, stack the loot and upgrade your ship. Unlock a variety of new abilities and become more powerful every run. Shoot, die, upgrade, and dive into space one more time.

In Drone Scout, every mission starts with something missing and one tiny drone ready to save the day.

Pilot a nimble quadcopter through a bright low-poly neighborhood, scanning streets, yards, parks, rooftops, and hidden corners to track down misplaced objects. From baseball bats and library books to keys, gift cards, and one very important guitar case, each level gives you a new item to recover and a new slice of town to explore.

Simple flying controls make it easy to lift off, look around, and enjoy the search, while each successful find brings a satisfying little rescue moment. Whether you are sweeping over sidewalks, hovering near backyards, or carefully checking around buildings, Drone Scout is all about calm exploration, observation, and the small joy of finding what was lost.
